headline: Government to decide today on cutting VAT on fuel
summary: The North Macedonian government will hold a session to approve a cut in fuel VAT from 18% to 10%, a measure announced by Prime Minister Hristijan Mickoski to ease rising fuel prices.
why: Fuel taxes change pump prices and household inflation, and government fiscal measures of this kind affect public finances and inflation expectations.
